United States Department of the Interior
GEOLOGICAL SURVEY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20242
May 8, 1972
Memorandum
To:
Chief, Office of Environmental Quality, Bureau of
Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
Through: Assistant Secretary--Mineral Resources
From:
Director, Geological Survey
Subject: Review of draft environmental statement for
H. R. 13111 -- "Endangered Species Conservation
Act of 1972"
We have reviewed the subject draft environmental statement and
have no comment on it.
